dedupe_keys.name: lod2 former datasets multi modal roof structure data for 3d building wireframe reconstruction

description: These two curated datasets align, for each building, aerial RGB imagery, a rasterised height map, a 3D point cloud and pixel-level roof-plane annotations, to train and evaluate roof wireframe reconstruction from combined LiDAR and imagery. They were published on Zenodo on 3 July 2026 by Youssef Abdelhedi, Daniel Panangian, Chaikal Amrullah and Ksenia Bittner of the German Aerospace Center (DLR) and Houda Chaabouni-Chouayakh of the Digital Research Centre of Sfax, with the LoD2-Former paper. The roofint archive covers about 3,585 buildings whose roof crops come from the mesh-image roof dataset of Ren and colleagues (2021); height maps and plane labels are projected from its planar roof meshes, and point clouds are sampled at 10,000 points per building, with train, validation and test splits and the Python scripts used. A second archive covers Tallinn. Coverage: the source areas of the Ren dataset and Tallinn, Estonia. Access: two archives of about 957 and 460 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free, subject to the terms of the source roof dataset. Caveats: the Tallinn archive was not described in the part of the metadata read. Simulation uses: automated LoD2 building models for digital twins and solar and energy studies. Related records: 3DBAG and the Glasgow 3D city models.
